input.summary: Keep ₱10,000.00 a month going to the emergency fund, and put the rest of the card money (₱10,000.00 a month) on the credit card, with the house fund still at ₱5,050.00. The fund is at 2.3 months of runway against a 3-month target and reaches it in 5 months on this plan. Putting the whole surplus on the card would stop the fund's growth, which goes against the household's choices to keep a cash buffer.
